== Editing the family navigator ==
This shared navigator appears in the Versions infobox of each article in the Premiere [[The Empire's Back]] family. To update membership, use the '''Edit versions''' link on a member article or edit this template's source. Each publication entry uses [[Template:Card version link]] with its canonical article title and concise visible label.

Add a verified publication here once and include <code><nowiki>{{Card versions/The Empire's Back (Premiere)}}</nowiki></code> in its card template's <code>versions</code> field. Keep its existing images, text and identity.

Membership is every verified existing article in this Premiere family. Do not invent printings.

[[The Empire's Back (V) (Virtual Block 1)]] is Virtual Legacy (<code>1210_67</code>). Short [[The Empire's Back (V)]] is Virtual Modern (<code>223_25o</code>). Original Virtual Set 2 faces stay under Virtual Original. Join era blocks with <code>&lt;/div&gt;&lt;/div&gt;&lt;!--</code> then <code>--&gt;&lt;div class="card-family-era"</code> so headings stay live.
